name: fd
description_en: A simple, fast and user-friendly alternative to 'find'
readme_excerpt: fd [中文] [한국어] fd is a program to find entries in your filesystem. It is a simple, fast and user-friendly alternative to find. While it does not aim to support all of find's powerful functionality, it provides sensible (opinionated) defaults for a majority of use cases. Installation • How to use • Troubleshooting Features Intuitive syntax: fd PATTERN instead of find -iname 'PATTERN'. Regular expression (default) and glob-based patterns.
